_comment: Client tools for the Future Maya agent. Names, parameter identifiers and types must match exactly what you enter in the ElevenLabs dashboard (Agent > Tools > Add tool > Client). The front end registers handlers with the same names in frontend/src/components/voice/VoiceSession.tsx. Parameters mirror backend/app/models.py WhatIfRequest and TransferRequest (minus `customer`, which the app fills in).

tools.name: update_plan
tools.description: Plan path only. Re-runs the plan-path forecast with a change the user describes (new job, raise or pay cut, move, big purchase, saving more, spending more, job loss, buying a home) and returns the new 2031 numbers plus one ready-made sentence to say. Only fill numbers the user actually said. Never call on the same path.

description.description: The change in the user's own words, e.g. 'What if I take the Austin job? $8,000 more a year, but rent is $300 higher.'

preset.description: Closest kind of change. Use custom if none fits.

income_change_yearly.description: Gross yearly pay change exactly as said, e.g. 8000 for '$8,000 more a year', -5000 for a $5,000 pay cut. Do not convert to monthly.

spending_change_monthly.description: Monthly spending change as said, e.g. 300 for 'rent is $300 higher'. Negative means spending less.

savings_change_monthly.description: Extra monthly saving as said, e.g. 100 for 'save $100 more a month'.

one_time_cost.description: A single purchase or cost as said, e.g. 2500 for a $2,500 trip.

job_loss_months.description: Months with no income, e.g. 3 for 'lose my job for 3 months'.

start_month.description: YYYY-MM when the change starts, only if the user said when. Leave empty otherwise.

home_price.description: Buy a home: the price as said, e.g. 250000.

home_down_payment.description: Buy a home: the down payment as said, e.g. 12500. If they gave a percent, leave it out and say you need the dollar amount.

home_rate.description: Buy a home: mortgage rate in percent as said, e.g. 6.5.

home_term_years.description: Buy a home: loan length in years. Leave out unless said (default 30).

tools.name: start_transfer
tools.description: Schedules the simulated next-step transfer. Call ONLY after the user clearly says yes to the amount, the accounts and how often. Returns the status and first date.

amount.description: Dollar amount per transfer from the fact sheet's NEXT STEP, e.g. 150.

from_account_id.description: Source account id. Use 'spend' (the Spend checking account).

to_account_id.description: Destination account id. Use 'reserve' (the Reserve savings account).

frequency.description: How often. Use 'payday' unless the user clearly asked otherwise.

confirmed.description: True only after a clear yes from the user to amount, accounts and frequency.

tools.name: highlight_metric
tools.description: Makes a number glow on screen when you mention it. Fire and forget; never mention it out loud.

metric_id.description: One of: same_path.2031.cushion_months, same_path.2031.card_debt, same_path.2031.car_paid_off, same_path.2031.ira, plan.2031.cushion_months, plan.2031.card_debt, plan.2031.car_paid_off, plan.2031.ira, next_step.score_2031. Use the ids for your own path.
